feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 12:13am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

SE 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, veering S-SW through the morning, then SW 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Mostly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain soon clearing to scattered showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C

Nil.

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good.

11°C

Nil.
